title: TAMAR: When God Redeems the Forgotten
paragraphs: TAMAR: When God Redeems the Forgotten
Brother John here — this one is uncomfortable, but holy.

Tamar was ignored.
Used.
Silenced by culture and family.
Her story in Genesis 38 is messy — scandalous, even.
But here’s the part many skip.

God did not erase her.
God elevated her.

Tamar is named in the lineage of Jesus Himself
(Matthew 1:3).
The Savior of the world came through a woman society tried to forget.

Hear me, kapatid:
If your story feels embarrassing…
If people only remember your mistake…
If you were wronged and left unseen…
God is not done writing your name.

Jesus doesn’t come from perfect families —
He comes to redeem broken ones.

“Judah the father of Perez and Zerah, whose mother was Tamar…”
— Matthew 1:3

Grace and peace, mga kapatid.
Keep fighting the good fight.
